question: Q7 / H7

population: Indonesian middle-class respondents (survey by Kedai Kopi)
proxy_note: Revisit reasons, national middle class; sampling method not stated
snippet: Sebanyak 83% responden mengaku melakukan kunjungan kembali ke kafe karena menu yang enak. Selain itu, sebanyak 78% responden mengaku menyukai ruangan yang nyaman sebagai penunjang loyalitas datang ke kafe. Sisanya menyukai pelayanan yang baik (70%), ruangan bersih (64%), fasilitas baik (45%), dan estetika (27%).
notes: Disconfirming for design-led revisits: aesthetics ranks last (27%); food and comfort lead. Multiple-answer list.

question: Q7 / H7

ref_period: Peer-reviewed article, Vol. 19 No. 1, February 2026 (fieldwork dates not stated in abstract)
population: Generation Z consumers of five coffee-shop brands in Jakarta; SEM (AMOS)
age_band_native: Gen Z (age cut-offs not in abstract)
proxy_note: Association only, cross-sectional, five brands; sampling method not stated in abstract; open access (CC BY)
snippet: In contrast, Servicescape does not significantly affect Customer Satisfaction among Generation Z consumers.
notes: Disconfirming for atmosphere-led satisfaction in Jakarta Gen Z. Service quality and food and beverage quality did significantly affect satisfaction; satisfaction and brand attitude both drive revisit intention. Authors state the cross-sectional design and geographic focus limit generalisability.
